raw_extraction.description: The Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) provides programmatic access to Amazon's selling partner services, enabling developers to automate and manage various aspects of selling on Amazon, including listings, orders, shipments, finances, and more.
raw_extraction.api_breadth: The API covers a wide range of functionalities including catalog items, orders, shipments, finances, listings, messaging, notifications, fulfillment, invoicing, and more, with extensive SDK support in multiple languages.
raw_extraction.mcp_notes: Amazon provides an official Selling Partner Appstore and a Service Provider Network for listing and managing applications and services.
raw_extraction.buildability_rationale: The API is officially documented with detailed onboarding steps, SDKs in multiple languages, and extensive API references, enabling developers to build applications integrating with Amazon Selling Partner services.
